name: Glance
author: Ayan De
description: Face unlock with liveness detection: armed state, enrolled identities, the last scan's verdict, and a test scan, in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel for the glanced face-unlock daemon: whether it is armed, who is enrolled, what the last scan decided and why, plus arm, disarm and test-scan actions.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the daemon's status is polled while idle. The panel refreshes on open and after every action regardless.

schema.label: glancectl path
schema.description: Optional. Leave empty to find glancectl on PATH; set it to the venv binary for a source checkout (e.g. ~/glance-linux/.venv/bin/glancectl).
